summary: This continuation completes the finite-rank Mennicke extension plan beyond the accepted U.1 part, identifies arithmetic relative defects and their compatible transitions, and separates the higher-rank and infinite-unit-rank SL₂ congruence-kernel routes. The plan exposes unresolved class-field, higher-unit, topological-completion and Hecke interfaces instead of assuming them.
